The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Safonne Pendon]] operated out of a '''base''' on the icy [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Seltaya Major]]. Home to two hundred pirates and Pendon's fleet of [[Starship/Legends|starships]], his base consisted of several levels hidden underground.
